nodes.description: Public MintConfig struct holding startIndex, endIndex, remaining, mintPrice, limits, version, flags and whitelistSigner.
Private mapping(string=>uint) counting mints per wallet key (address+version).
Private mapping(uint=>uint) caching token index swap used by the random mint strategy.
Public total supply counter incremented on mint and decremented on burn.
Public total minted counter.
Public total burned counter.
GuestlistedArtProxy instance used to render token SVG images.
Public boolean toggling whether burning is allowed.
Ownable private owner address guarding onlyOwner functions.
Payable nonReentrant mint entrypoint: checks config, whitelist signature, holder status, per-wallet limit, then mints random or sequential tokens.
External burn: checks isBurnActive, token existence and owner, then decrements supply and burns.
Builds and base64 encodes the on-chain JSON metadata using getTokenData and artProxyContract.draw.
Private view assembling a full TokenData struct (venue, dj, colors, shape, date).
Internal function returning a pseudo-random token index using random() and mintCache swap logic.
Internal view returning keccak256 of block.timestamp, block.difficulty and input.
Internal pure returning keccak256 of the input string as a deterministic number.
Internal pure deriving a formatted date string from a token id.
onlyOwner function transferring the full contract balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function updating or pushing a venue at an index (-1 pushes).
onlyOwner function updating or pushing a DJ at an index (-1 pushes).
onlyOwner function overwriting the whole mintConfig struct.
onlyOwner function toggling mintConfig.isActive.
onlyOwner function toggling isBurnActive.
Internal ERC721 safe mint that mints and then checks the receiver contract.
Private ERC721 hook performing an external call to onERC721Received on contract recipients.
Deploys config, venues, djs, text colors and mints the owner reserve tokens.
View returning an array of token ids owned by an address by brute-force scanning.
Ownable function transferring ownership, guarded by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner function replacing custom metadata arrays for a set of token ids.
onlyOwner function replacing custom attribute arrays for a set of token ids.
Caller-controlled address used for whitelist recovery, holder checks, mint limits, burn ownership and withdraw.
Miner-influenceable block data used as randomness seed.
Low-level external call to recipient's onERC721Received during safe mint.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) sending the entire contract balance.
External call to artProxyContract.draw on an owner-controlled address during tokenURI.
ECDSA signature recovery of the minter address for whitelist validation.
Parameter of mint: number of tokens requested in a single transaction.
Parameter of mint: whitelist signature bytes passed to ECDSA.recover.
Parameter of burn: id of the token to burn.
Local of mint: string key combining msg.sender and mintConfig.version for mintedPerWallet.
Local of mint: address recovered from the supplied whitelist signature.
Parameter of tokenURI: token id whose metadata is requested.
Local of getTokenData: TokenData struct assembled for a token.
Local of getRandomTokenIndex: timestamp-derived pseudo-random number.
Parameter of getRandomTokenIndex: address used as random seed.
Parameter of updateVenue: index of the venue to update, -1 to append.
Parameter of updateVenue: Venue struct written to storage.
Parameter of updateDJ: index of the DJ to update, -1 to append.
Parameter of updateDJ: DJ struct written to storage.
Local of withdraw: contract balance read before transfer.
Parameter of tokensOfOwner: address whose tokens are enumerated.
Local of tokensOfOwner: returned array of owned token ids.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the minter; drives whitelist recovery, holder check, per-wallet limit and mint recipient.
burn requires msg.sender to be the token owner.
withdraw transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender guarded by onlyOwner.
random() seeds from block.timestamp, making the pseudo-randomness miner-influenceable.
getRandomTokenIndex derives its index from timestamp-based random output.
mint calls getRandomTokenIndex when mintConfig.isRandom is true.
mint calls _safeMint inside the mint loops before state is fully settled.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external callback to the recipient contract.
mint updates mintedPerWallet for the minter key.
mint writes mintCache in the sequential branch.
mint reads flags/price and decrements mintConfig.remaining.
mint increments totalSupply per token.
mint increments minted per token.
mint verifies the whitelist signature via ECDSA recover.
getRandomTokenIndex reads and swaps entries in mintCache.
getRandomTokenIndex uses mintConfig.remaining and startIndex.
withdraw sends the contract balance through a raw transfer.
withdraw is restricted to the owner stored in _owner.
tokenURI calls getTokenData to assemble token metadata.
tokenURI reads the artProxyContract state variable.
tokenURI triggers an external draw call on the art proxy contract.
artProxyContract is the target of the external draw call.
getTokenData calls deterministic for deterministic numbers.
getTokenData calls random for the random number.
getTokenData calls getDate for the token date.
getDate calls deterministic on the token id string.
updateVenue is guarded by onlyOwner.
updateDJ is guarded by onlyOwner.
updateMintConfig is guarded by onlyOwner.
owner overwrites the whole mintConfig including price, limits and whitelistSigner.
flipMintState toggles mintConfig.isActive.
flipBurnState toggles isBurnActive.
burn decrements totalSupply.
burn increments burned.
burn checks isBurnActive before proceeding.
transferOwnership updates _owner and is onlyOwner guarded.
constructor pushes venues via updateVenue.
constructor pushes djs via updateDJ.
constructor initialises mintConfig via updateMintConfig.
constructor mints the owner reserve using _safeMint which can invoke a receiver callback.
constructor mutates mintConfig.remaining while minting owner reserve.
_nbTokens is multiplied by mintPrice and added to mintedPerWallet entries.
signature bytes are passed into ECDSA recover for whitelist checking.
burn uses _tokenId for existence and ownership checks.
minterKey indexes the mintedPerWallet mapping.
recoveredSigner is compared against mintConfig.whitelistSigner in mint.
tokenURI token id selects custom attributes and metadata arrays.
tokenData is assembled and returned by getTokenData.
randomNumber derived from timestamp-based randomness drives the token index.
senderAddress is hashed inside getRandomTokenIndex.
_index selects the venue slot to overwrite or append.
_venue is the owner-supplied venue data written to storage.
_index selects the DJ slot to overwrite or append.
_dj is the owner-supplied DJ data written to storage.
balance is read and then transferred out in withdraw.
_ownerAddress drives the ownership scan in tokensOfOwner.
tokens array is filled and returned by tokensOfOwner.

Intermediate access-control value compared against whitelistSigner inside mint.
Token identifier argument used solely by tokenURI metadata assembly.
Struct built and returned exclusively by getTokenData.
Timestamp-derived local used only to compute the random token index.
Seed argument passed to random() within getRandomTokenIndex.
Owner-supplied index controlling venue storage writes.
Owner-supplied venue struct written to storage.
Owner-supplied index controlling DJ storage writes.
Owner-supplied DJ struct written to storage.
Balance local used only for the owner-only transfer in withdraw.
Argument that bounds the ownership scan loop.
Result array allocated and returned by tokensOfOwner.
